measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potentials for amino-modified (PS-NH2), carboxyl-modified (PS-COOH), and unmodified (PS-Bare) particles were measured at 34.2 ± 5.52 mV, -20.6 ± 3.69 mV, and -0.663 ± 4.94 mV, respectively. || Zeta potential was measured using a Zetasizer Nano ZS90 (Malvern Panalytical, UK).
measurements.evidence_location: Results, Particle Characterization; Methods, Nanoparticle Characterization
